author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇺🇸 Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber died yesterday at a rehab facility at just 27.

He was fashion royalty from birth, the son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and Casamigos co-founder Rande Gerber, and older brother of model Kaia Gerber.

He walked his first runway for Moschino at 16, then went on to walk for Burberry and Dolce & Gabbana and front campaigns for Calvin Klein, Celine and Omega.

He never hid what he was going through and talked openly about his addiction and mental health, which was rare for a family that always kept things private.

Things took a dark turn last December, when he posted a video saying he was on antidepressants and Xanax for panic attacks after "a lot of loss in many different forms recently."

From the outside it looked like he had the perfect life, and he spent his last years showing everyone how little that picture tells you.

Source: CNN / Writer: Daniyal
